fields.name: Sudoku
fields.description: Classic 9x9 number puzzle. Fill the grid so each row, column, and 3x3 box contains digits 1-9.
fields.icon_svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><line x1="15" y1="3" x2="15" y2="21"/><line x1="3" y1="9" x2="21" y2="9"/><line x1="3" y1="15" x2="21" y2="15"/></svg>

fields.name: KenKen
fields.description: Math-based logic puzzle. Fill the grid using arithmetic operations in each cage.
fields.icon_svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><text x="6" y="10" font-size="6" fill="currentColor">+</text><text x="14" y="10" font-size="6" fill="currentColor">-</text><text x="6" y="18" font-size="6" fill="currentColor">x</text><text x="14" y="18" font-size="6" fill="currentColor">/</text></svg>

fields.name: Nonogram
fields.description: Picture logic puzzle. Use number clues to reveal a hidden image by filling cells.
fields.icon_svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><rect x="6" y="6" width="4" height="4" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="14" y="6" width="4" height="4" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="10" y="10" width="4" height="4" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="6" y="14" width="4" height="4" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="4" height="4" fill="currentColor"/></svg>

fields.name: Word Ladder
fields.description: Transform one word into another by changing one letter at a time. Each step must be a valid word.
fields.icon_svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="4" y="4" width="5" height="5" rx="1"/><rect x="10" y="4" width="5" height="5" rx="1"/><rect x="16" y="4" width="4" height="5" rx="1"/><line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="12"/><path d="M8 12h8M8 12l2-2M8 12l2 2M16 12l-2-2M16 12l-2 2"/><rect x="4" y="15" width="5" height="5" rx="1"/><rect x="10" y="15" width="5" height="5" rx="1"/><rect x="16" y="15" width="4" height="5" rx="1"/></svg>

fields.name: Memory Matrix
fields.description: Memory challenge. Watch the pattern, then recreate it from memory. Tests visual working memory.
fields.icon_svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.3"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.3"/></svg>
